description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Ice 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Fire 2 with Stacking] to the user if the entry damage was Ice/FIre, [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode] and [Zenith Mode: Squall] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Squall
description.text: Increases [Fire or Ice Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, Fire or Ice abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Squall after using a Fire or Ice ability (max 5), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Spirit Attack: Squall
description.text: Grants [(Ice/Fire) Ability +30% Boost 1] to the user

description.name: Attach Ice 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Fire 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
